title: Crash camera keeps the separated rider in frame
summary: A tight severe-crash camera now prioritizes the rider when the ATV separates, fitting only the rider torso and chassis while debris remains outside the framing target.
details: Host gate: make check, make verify, and make web passed (Rust formatting/tests/strict Clippy, JavaScript 135 passed and 1 skipped, and Python checks).

The actual-WASM severe-crash browser route passed 1,202 paired native gameplay/camera steps with zero mismatches, three intact-ATV aerial ragdoll frames, two damage transitions, seven damaged parts, and recovery.

During rider separation the camera dolly stays within 16–32 feet; the bike fades out of focus at 8–22 feet, and terrain lifts the eye. A previously saved shake preference is ignored and the shake control is removed.
limitation: Host-only evidence. Public deployment and browser verification are pending. Speed-triggered peripheral blur and the crisp HD UI are not implemented yet.
